metadata.title: Many big-name stocks have rallied on IPO day. Will SpaceX join the club? - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 days ago
Many big-name stocks have rallied on IPO day. Will SpaceX join the club?
Public debuts of key U.S. companies stretching back more than two decades show big rallies for many on their first day of trading, according to a compilation by Dow Jones Market Data. Key for SpaceX will be following in the footsteps of those companies — and avoiding Meta’s early fate.
Take Airbnb, for example. The company’s stock soared 113% after the December 2020 initial public offering, the most out of a list of big names that includes recent market debuts such as Cerebras as well as now-mainstays like Snap and Tesla, Elon Musk’s first public company.
Shares of Snowflake had the second largest first-day gain. Following a September 2020 IPO, the software company’s shares gained 112% on their first day of trading. DoorDash, which also debuted in 2020, came third, with an initial stock pop of 86%.
